map.💡 所需样本量 n₀=Z²p(1−p)/e²；实际误差 e=Z·√[p(1−p): 💡 Required sample size n₀=Z²p(1−p)/e²; actual error e=Z·√[p(1−p)/n]·√[(N−n)/(N−1)]; stratification allocates by n_i=n·N_i/N proportional.

map.分层抽样按各层规模比例分配配额，保证样本结构与总体一致。: Stratified sampling allocates quotas by each stratum size proportion, keeping the sample structure consistent with the population.
map.95% 置信、±5% 误差需要多少样本: How many samples for 95% confidence and ±5% error
map.置信水平 95%（z = 1.96）、预期比例 p = 50%（最保守）、允许误: Confidence level 95% (z = 1.96), expected proportion p = 50% (most conservative), allowed error e = 5%, infinite population: n₀ = 1.96² × 0.5 × 0.5 ÷ 0.05² = 384.16 → at least 385 copies. If population N = 5,000 with finite population correction: n = 384.16 ÷ (1 + 383.16/5,000) = 356.8 → 357 copies, 28 fewer than the infinite case. Reverse check: at n = 385 the actual error = 1.96 × √(0.25/385) = 4.99%, consistent with the set 5%.
map.为什么预期比例默认取 50%？: Why is the expected proportion default 50%?
map.p(1−p) 在 p = 50% 时取最大值，算出的样本量最保守。若你确信比例接: p(1−p) reaches its maximum at p = 50%, giving the most conservative sample size. If you are sure the proportion is near 0 or 1 (e.g. a rare behavior 5%), using the actual proportion can significantly reduce the sample size.
map.什么时候要用有限总体校正？: When should the finite population correction be used?
map.当抽样比 n/N 超过约 5% 时，校正能明显减少所需样本。勾选总体规模后工具自: When the sampling ratio n/N exceeds about 5%, the correction can noticeably reduce the required sample. After checking population size, the tool auto-applies the √((N−n)/(N−1)) factor; if the population is very large, check infinite population.
